name: Ski erg
description: Pull the ski erg handles down with your arms and hips in a steady rhythm.
caution: Pace the first 500 metres. Sprinting early leads to a fast fade.

name: Sled push
description: Push a loaded sled across the floor with a low, driving stance.
caution: Keep the trunk braced and the arms straight. Stop if your lower back rounds.

name: Sled pull
description: Pull a sled toward you hand over hand, walking backward at a steady pace.

name: Burpee broad jump
description: Do a burpee, then broad jump forward instead of standing up.
caution: High impact on the knees and wrists. Scale to step-backs if you feel joint pain.

name: Farmers carry
description: Walk while holding heavy weights at your sides with a tall posture.

name: Wall ball
description: Squat, then throw a medicine ball to a target on the wall as you stand.
caution: Squat deep and drive through the legs. Keep the throw overhead controlled.

name: Rowing 500 metres
description: Row 500 metres at a hard but controlled pace.

name: Sandbag lunge
description: Hold a sandbag on your shoulders and lunge forward, alternating legs.

name: Easy run 1 km
description: Run one kilometre at a comfortable pace you could hold a conversation at.

name: Rowing intervals
description: Alternate hard rowing efforts with easy recovery strokes.

name: Slow farmer walk
description: Walk slowly holding a light pair of dumbbells, keeping your shoulders down and your chest tall.
